feature: Budgeted per-conversion exact sRGB16 lookup table for images at least 65536 pixels
contract: Uses original f32 normalization and transfer expression for each of 65536 channel values
Applies only sRGB/assumed-sRGB RGBA16, not BT.709 or floating HDR
Optional scratch reserve 262144 bytes; refused reservation or allocation falls back to scalar conversion
Cancellation checked during table construction and image iteration

checks: exhaustive channel bit equivalence including alpha
exact output-only budget succeeds via scalar fallback
scratch budget peak and output ownership asserted

limits: Sequential dev-profile before/after on generated warm-cache source; not randomized controlled benchmark
Does not accelerate ICC transforms, BT709 or floating source transfer
No broad format or cold-storage speed claim
